s: UKMTO has received a report of an incident in the Strait of Hormuz. A Company Security Officer has informed UKMTO that their tanker has been struck by an unknown projectile whilst completing an outbound transit of the Strait of Hormuz. There are no reported injuries to the crew or environmental impact report at this time. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

UKMTO WARNING 179-26 - ATTACK Incident Date:21 Oct 2026 Incident Time:0145UTC Local Authorities UKMTO has received a report of an incident 11NM west of Bukha, Oman. Local Authorities have reported that a Tanker has been struck by an unknown projectile which started a fire which has been extinguished. The Tanker is now at anchor. All crew are reported as safe. There is no reported environmental impact at this time. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

UKMTO Suspicious Activity 165-26 UKMTO has received a report of an incident involving a tanker in the vicinity of Sohar anchorage, Oman. The status of crew, damage assessment, and environmental impact are unknown at time of report. Update 001: UKMTO has reclassified this incident as an attack following confirmation that the tanker was struck by an Uncrewed Aerial Vehicle (UAV). Local authorities are assisting in the evacuation of the crew, damage assessment and environmental impact is unknown at time of update. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO whilst authorities investigate.

UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident occurring on the evening of 28SEP2026 in the Strait of Hormuz. UKMTO has received a third-party report of a vessel struck by a suspected unknown projectile while transiting the Strait of Hormuz, resulting in a fire. The fire has since been extinguished and the vessel is underway. Crew are safe, there has been no reported environmental impact or damage assessment. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

UKMTO WARNING 078-26 - SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY Report Date: 01 Jul 2026 Report Time:0945UTC Issue Date: 01 Jul 2026 Source: Master UKMTO has received a report of an incident 85NM south of Balhaf, Yemen. The Master of a tanker had reported a small craft approached the vessel on the port quarter at 2NM. The small craft was described as having a low freeboard and orange interior with 4 POB. The small craft has now left the vicinity proceeding south. The crew are reported as safe and the vessel is continuing on its voyage. Authorities are investigating. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.
